name: Oak
about: Oak comes directly from the mighty oak tree, one of the world's most enduring symbols of strength, wisdom and resilience. Across many cultures the oak represents stability, longevity and a deep connection to the natural world. Strong, minimalist and timeless, Oak is a distinctive gender-neutral name inspired by one of nature's most iconic trees.

name: Ocean
about: Ocean comes directly from the English word describing Earth's vast interconnected seas. It evokes freedom, exploration, depth and the endless rhythm of nature. Expansive, adventurous and unmistakably modern, Ocean is a memorable gender-neutral name that celebrates the beauty and power of the natural world.

name: October
about: October comes from the Latin word 'octo,' meaning 'eight,' reflecting its place in the ancient Roman calendar. Today the month is celebrated for colourful autumn landscapes, crisp air and seasonal change. Warm, distinctive and full of atmosphere, October is a creative gender-neutral name inspired by one of the year's most memorable seasons.

name: Olive
about: Olive comes from the olive tree, one of humanity's oldest cultivated plants. Across cultures the olive branch has become an enduring symbol of peace, hope and reconciliation, while the tree itself represents resilience and abundance. Elegant, gentle and timeless, Olive is a beautiful gender-neutral name rooted in nature and history.

name: Onyx
about: Onyx takes its name from the striking black gemstone prized for centuries in jewellery and sculpture. The stone has traditionally symbolised protection, confidence and inner strength while remaining closely connected to the natural world. Bold, sophisticated and memorable, Onyx is a powerful gender-neutral name inspired by one of nature's most distinctive minerals.

name: Orion
about: Orion comes from Greek mythology, where Orion was the legendary hunter, and today it is one of the most recognisable constellations in the night sky. The name naturally evokes exploration, courage and wonder beneath the stars. Bold, timeless and unmistakably celestial, Orion is one of the strongest gender-neutral names inspired by mythology and astronomy.

name: Oslo
about: Oslo is the capital city of Norway, with a name that traces back to Old Norse roots traditionally interpreted as referring to a meadow beneath a hill. Surrounded by forests and fjords, the city is closely associated with Scandinavian nature and outdoor life. Clean, modern and internationally recognisable, Oslo is a distinctive gender-neutral place name.

name: Otis
about: Otis developed from medieval names related to Otto and Odo, which are associated with wealth and prosperity. Long established as both a surname and given name, it has enjoyed a modern revival thanks to its vintage charm and friendly simplicity. Timeless, approachable and distinctive, Otis is a classic gender-neutral choice with enduring appeal.

name: Owyn
about: Owyn is a modern spelling inspired by the traditional Welsh name Owen. While contemporary in form, it retains the warmth, simplicity and Celtic character that have made Owen popular for generations. Fresh, approachable and distinctive, Owyn is a modern gender-neutral choice that blends Welsh inspiration with contemporary style.

name: Ozzy
about: Ozzy began as an affectionate nickname for names such as Oswald and Osborne before becoming an established given name in its own right. Its energetic sound and friendly personality have helped it grow in popularity as a modern standalone choice. Playful, memorable and effortlessly contemporary, Ozzy is a distinctive gender-neutral name with historic roots.
